sentences.japanese: 列車が発車する準備が整った。
sentences.english: The train is ready to start.

sentences.japanese: 我が社もすぐにインターネットにアクセスできる環境を整えなくては取り残されてしまう。
sentences.english: If we don't create an environment that enables instant Internet access, our company will also fall behind.

sentences.japanese: もう少し環境を整えてほしい。
sentences.english: I want you to straighten up the environment a little more.

sentences.japanese: ポッターさんは毎日ジョギングをすることで調子を整えています。
sentences.english: Mr Potter keeps himself in good condition by going jogging every day.

sentences.japanese: ベッドを整えるために誰かよこして下さいますか。
sentences.english: Could you send someone up to make the bed?
